propositions: AGENTS.md currently claims symbol tools (LSP) are universally preferable to grep for finding references, but this is false when symbols are referenced by string literals (e.g. monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib)
LSP symbol resolution cannot detect symbols named as string literals and therefore misses call sites that use dynamic attribute setting or lookup
LSP index can become stale after recent edits, causing reported line numbers to diverge from the current working tree
grep produces false positives (e.g. matches in comments) that LSP does not, creating a trade-off rather than a strict preference
AGENTS.md must replace the unconditional preference with a decision table mapping use cases to appropriate tools (LSP for semantic references, grep for string literals and current line numbers)
